metadata.name: UpdateCo-signerDetails
metadata.description: Purpose of this API is used to update the Cosigner's details.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/CustomerID is required.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/CustomerID is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CustomerID
request_fields.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abc2123 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/CustomerID is required. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CosignerTitle
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Title like MR or MRS. Valid Values:Refer Appendix section 5.7 Format: xx Example: 01 = MR, 16 = Col, 17 = Judge Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CosignerFirstName
request_fields.description: Cosigner's First Name Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s First Name is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:John Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerMiddleName
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Middle Name valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:User1 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerLastName
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Last Name Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s Last Name is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:Davis Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Address Line 1 Condition: If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s Address Line 1 is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Address Line 2 valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerCity
request_fields.description: Cosigner's City valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Condition: If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s City is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Format:XXXXX Example:Chicago Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CosignerState
request_fields.description: Cosigner's State valid Values: Refer Appendix Section State Codes Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s State is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerPostalCode
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Postal Code Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s Postal Code is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:99501 Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerCountry
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Country Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s Country is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Valid Values: Refer appendix section Country Code Values Example:US Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerEmailID
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Email ID Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s Email ID is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerHomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Home Phone Number valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:9974865836 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: CosignerWorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Work Phone Number valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:9758356383 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: CosignerMobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Mobile Phone Number. Condition: If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s Mobile Phone Number is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 11

request_fields.name: CosignerOtherPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Other Phone Number. valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 11

request_fields.name: CosignerFaxNumber
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Fax number. valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 11

request_fields.name: CosignerCreditFilePhone
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Credit File Phone Number. valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 11

request_fields.name: CosignerAlternatePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Alternate Phone Number valid Values:0-9 Example:9738758349 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: CosignerMobileCarrier
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Mobile carrier company Valid Values:A-z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXX Example: c.vodafone.ne.jp, csouth1.com, m1.com.sg Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerDateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Cosigner's date of birth valid Values:0-9 Format: MM/dd/YYYY Example:11/23/1980

request_fields.name: CosignerResidenceType
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Residence Type Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s Residence Type is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Valid Values:ReferAppendix Section -Residence Ownership Code Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CosignerDurationatAddress
request_fields.description: Identifies the Cosigner's provided address is a bad address. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxx Example: 12 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: CosignerBadAddress
request_fields.description: Identifies the Cosigner's provided address is a bad address. Valid Values:0 or 1 Format: x Example: 1

request_fields.name: CosignerMaritalStatus
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Marital Status Valid Values: 0,1 Format: x Example: 0- No, 1 - Yes

request_fields.name: CosignerSSN
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Social Security Number Condition: If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s Social Security Number is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:987456321

request_fields.name: CosignerGender
request_fields.description: Gender of Cosigner. Valid Values: 0 - No information available 1 -Male 2-Female Format:X Example:1 Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: CosignerCeaseandDesist
request_fields.description: This tag reflects whenever Cosigner is ceased or desist the CoreCOLLECT user need not follow up the mapped account holder thus all the credentials of the mapped account holders are erased from the dialer file using this flag. Valid Values:0 or 1 Format:X Example:1

request_fields.name: CeaseDesistCommunication
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Cease and Desist communication Valid Values: Available in Appendix section 5.36 Format: xxxxxx Example: litigation, Phone and Mail etc

request_fields.name: CosignerBankruptcy
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Flag for Bankruptcy Valid Values: 0,1 Format: x Example: 0-no, 1-yes

request_fields.name: CosignerBankruptcyNotificationDate
request_fields.description: Cosigner's bankruptcy notification date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:12/20/2019 12:18:19 Condition: This field is mandatory when CosignerBankruptcy is checked.

request_fields.name: CosignerDeceased
request_fields.description: This tag reflects whether the Cosigner is deceased or not . Valid Values: 0-9 Format: 0 or 1 Example: 0

request_fields.name: CosignerDeceasedNotificationDate
request_fields.description: Date when deceased is notified. Format:MM/DD/YYYY Example:02/20/2020 Condition:This field is mandatory when CosignerDeceased tag is checked.

request_fields.name: CosignerEmploymentType
request_fields.description: Type of employement of Cosigner. Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner Employment Type is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Valid Values: Refer Appendix section 5.35 Format: xxxxx Example: 1

request_fields.name: CosignerCombinedTotalIncome
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Combined Total Income valid Values:0-9 Example:10000 Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s Combined Total Income is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional.

request_fields.name: CosignerMonthsOfEmployment
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Number on months in current employment Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:32

request_fields.name: CosignerPosition
request_fields.description: Employement position of the Cosigner. valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:Manager Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerEmployeeNumber
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Employee Number Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 7895463214 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CosignerEmployerName
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Employer Name. Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if Cosigner’s Employer Name is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:john Condition:Report the name of the employer for the consumer reported in the Base Segment in CBR Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerEmployerAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Employer Address Line 1 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerEmployerAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Employer Address Line 2 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerEmployerPostalCode
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Employer PostalCode. valid Values:0-9 Format:xxxx Example:123456 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: CosignerEmployerPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Employer phone number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CosignerEmployerFaxNumber
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Employer Fax number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7895463214 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CosignerEmployerCity
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Employer City. valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:kansas Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CosignerEmployerCountry
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Employer Country. valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:US Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CosignerEmployerState
request_fields.description: Cosigner's Employer State. valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:CA Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CosignerGovernmentIDType
request_fields.description: Government issued identification Type. Government Id Type Code should be passed in the request and not the description. Condition: If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if CosignerGovernmentIDType is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Valid Values:Refer Appendix section ID Type Values Example:03 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CosignerIDNumber
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Government ID Number. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXXXXX Example::CDDT9741Q Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 and ‘CosignerGovernmentIDType’ has any value, then it is mandatory but if CosignerIDNumber is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CosignerIDIssueCountry
request_fields.description: Cosigner's ID Issue Country valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example:US Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 and ‘CosignerGovernmentIDType’ has any value, then it is mandatory but if Cosigner’s ID Issue Country is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CosignerIDIssueState
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s ID Issue State valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example:Alabama Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 and ‘CosignerGovernmentIDType’ has any value, then it is mandatory but if Cosigner’s ID Issue State is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CosignerIDIssueDate
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Government ID Issue Date Valid Values:0-9 Format:MM/DD/YYYY Example:02/01/2020 Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 and ‘CosignerGovernmentIDType’ has any value, then it is mandatory but if Cosigner’s Government ID Issue Date is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional

request_fields.name: CosignerIDExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Cosigner’s Government ID Expiry Date. Format:MM/DD/YYYY Example:02/01/2025 Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 and ‘CosignerGovernmentIDType’ has any value, then it is mandatory but if Cosigner’s Government ID Expiry Date is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional.

request_fields.name: CosignerHomePhoneNumberTechType
request_fields.description: Tech Type of Home Phone Number. Valid Values: 0 / 1 Format: x Example: 0 = Mobile, 1 = Landline Condition:I6129

request_fields.name: CosignerMobileNumberTechType
request_fields.description: Tech Type of Mobile Number. Valid Values: 0 / 1 Format: x Example: 0 = Mobile, 1 = Landline Condition:I6129

request_fields.name: CosignerWorkPhoneNumberTechType
request_fields.description: Tech Type of Work Phone Number. Valid Values: 0 / 1 Format: x Example: 0 = Mobile, 1 = Landline Condition:I6129

request_fields.name: CosignerOtherPhoneNumberTechType
request_fields.description: Tech Type of other  Phone Number. Valid Values: 0 / 1 Format: x Example: 0 = Mobile, 1 = Landline Condition:I6129

request_fields.name: CosignerFaxNumberTechType
request_fields.description: Tech Type of Fax Number. Valid Values: 0 / 1 Format: x Example: 0 = Mobile, 1 = Landline Condition:I6129

request_fields.name: CosignerCreditFilePhoneTechType
request_fields.description: Tech Type of Credit File Phone Number. Valid Values: 0 / 1 Format: x Example: 0 = Mobile, 1 = Landline Condition:I6129

request_fields.name: CosignerAlternatePhoneTechType
request_fields.description: Tech Type of Alternate Phone Number. Valid Values: 0 / 1 Format: x Example: 0 = Mobile, 1 = Landline Condition:I6129

request_fields.name: CosignerFraudVictim
request_fields.description: Identifies the Cosigner as Fraud victim. Valid Values:0 or 1 Format: x Example: 1 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: CosignerStatus
request_fields.description: Status of Cosigner. Valid Values: 1 = Active / 0 = Inactive Format: x Example: Condition:

request_fields.name: CosignerSNSuffix
request_fields.description: CosignerSNSuffix Condition:If CosignerFlag = 1 then mandatory but if CosignerSNSuffix is set as non-mandatory on product, then this tag is Optional. valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerLanguageIndicator
request_fields.description: Cosigner's preferred language. valid Values:A-Z,a-z Format: xx Example:Eng Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: CosignerSuppressEmail
request_fields.description: CosignerSuppressEmail valid Values: 0/1 Example:0

request_fields.name: OptoutForEmailMarketing
request_fields.description: OptoutForEmailMarketing Valid Values: 0/1 Example: 0

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
